name: com.shrinivasn/kannada-typing
title: Kannada Typing
description: Turns Kannada typed in English letters into Kannada script.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Turns Kannada typed in English letters (casual spelling, e.g. "namaskara", "hegiddira") into Kannada script. Handles whole sentences; numbers, punctuation, links and emails are kept as typed. Up to 2,000 characters per call. Lists words it was unsure of, with other choices.

text.description: Kannada written in English letters, up to 2,000 characters
